title: Mutable Data
subtitle: Local state, shared identity and mutable links
description: Build stateful closures, trace aliases and link updates, count actual pair expansions, and connect multiple access routes to one shared history.
estimateNote: Author estimate, not learner-measured: about 2200 prose words at 200 words/minute plus code/figure study, about 25 minutes; exercises about 15, 15, 15, 10, 15 minutes. Total about 95 minutes; optional book text excluded.
